Title: New and improved Azure Service Health dashboard

Body.Content: We are are introducing a new and improved Azure Status dashboard at status.azure.com. With the new health dashboard you are able to personalize the dashboard to display the services and regions that you care about, and subscribe to RSS feeds for all services or only those that interest you.
